Lone Wolf.note: Choice: 20% more damage with no pet, so it conflicts with every pet talent (Unleashed Fury, Frenzy, Spirit Bond, Focused Fire).

Focused Fire.note: Needs an active pet; conflicts with Lone Wolf.

Frenzy.note: Pet crits → faster pet attacks. Pet talent; useless with Lone Wolf.

Spirit Bond.note: Pet talent; useless with Lone Wolf.

Endurance Training.note: Pet talent; useless with Lone Wolf.

Bestial Swiftness.note: Pet talent; useless with Lone Wolf.

Bestial Discipline.note: Half pet Focus, half mana regen while casting.

Careful Aim.note: Turns Intellect into Attack Power: gear with Intellect counts twice.

Expose Prey.note: Combo: keep Hunter's Mark up → melee and ranged hits can enable Mongoose Bite.

Lacerating Strikes.note: Mongoose Bite also bleeds; more Mongoose Bites (Expose Prey) mean more bleeds.

Rapid Killing.note: Kills under Serpent Sting empower your next Shot; shorter Rapid Fire cooldown.

Rapid Recuperation.note: Resource loop: Serpent Sting lets mana regen continue while casting.

Entrapment.note: Traps also root everything they hit.
